messages.author: c593765222db4c71
messages.subject: Chinese character in plot
parts:
Hi Shiny guys:

I met a problem when I tried to add Chinese title, text, or legend to plot or ggplot. It looks some characters can display correctly, while others just messed up. 
For example, when I added "中国发电站”to the plot, it showed "中口口口站“. The first and last characters display correctly, but the three characters in the middle have problems. 
Here is the link to my ShinyApp http://glimmer.rstudio.com/jianhua/China/ 

Thanks for any suggestion.

Jianhua
